rounds.prompt: How many people speak Portuguese as their first language?
rounds.source: Ethnologue (2026 edition): about 252 million first-language Portuguese speakers

rounds.prompt: The Soviet Union split into 15 countries in 1991. How many people live in those 15 countries today?
rounds.source: World Bank population estimates for 2024, summed across the 15 former Soviet republics

rounds.prompt: Wembley Stadium is sold out, and every seat holds an adult. How many natural teeth are in the stands?
rounds.source: Wembley Stadium (90,000 seats) and the Adult Oral Health Survey 2021 (25.4 natural teeth on average)
